description: Prepare a user-signable exact-input swap against one allowlisted Base PancakeSwap V3 pool. Insight obtains a pinned quote and re-verifies the Factory, QuoterV2, Pool, and Router runtime identities before returning unsigned approval and swap calldata. It never receives a key, signs, relays, or broadcasts a transaction.

amountIn.description: Exact input amount of the direction input token; the tool never handles native ETH

direction.description: Quote direction inside the reviewed pool, stated in its token0/token1 order (e.g. Base USDC/USDT: USDC→USDT; BNB USDT/USDC: USDT→USDC) or the reverse. Defaults to token0→token1.

profileId.description: Reviewed PancakeSwap V3 pool id (Base or BNB Smart Chain); defaults to Base USDC/USDT 0.01%

name: prepare_pancakeswap_v3_swap
